text:
Nina: kicking off Marlin LoRA stitch + int8 quant smoke. quickpack (marlin-claims-v1) flagged percent/currency separators and negative amount formatting on the int8 artifact. attaching short logs.
Leo: what failures exactly? sample?
Nina: baseline -> 'Amount: -$1,234.56 (−1,234.56 USD)'; int8 -> 'Amount: minus one comma two three four point five six dollars' and '12% APR' -> '0.12' in text body which breaks downstream rule-checker. also percent sign dropped in a few cases.
Aisha: interesting. we usually see spelled-out numerals when tokenizer merges cross-token boundaries after quantization or LoRA scaling. Which tokenizer did Marlin use?
Nina: config: ```
merge: lora_stitch
quant: int8
tokenizer: bpe-uncased-v1
number_preserve: off
kv_alignment: auto
```
Leo: two likely culprits: (a) merge changed token-piece alignments for numeric runs, (b) int8 kernel fallback altered logits for number tokens. Does fp32/fp16 baseline show the issue?
Nina: fp16 clean. int8 reproducible on 120/200 samples in quickpack.
Aisha: short-term mitigation: add a shadow postprocess that normalizes numeric tokens back to canonical forms (ISO currency + explicit percent). longer-term: set number_preserve:on in stitch pipeline and re-run stitch -> quant. I prefer re-stitch so we avoid shadow fixes.
Leo: agree. also add a tokenizer alignment check in merge CI: feed golden tokens for currencies, percents, negatives, thousand separators and assert exact token boundaries. can you add those to marlin-claims-v1 evalpack?
Nina: adding tests to evalpack now. Will also try a shadow deploy to validate quick mitigation. Command: `rdwctl deploy --model marlin-lora:stitch4 --shadow number-preserve-pp --evalpack marlin-claims-v1 --limit 150`
deploy-bot: deployment queued: marlin-lora:stitch4 (shadow: number-preserve-pp) — evalpack marlin-claims-v1 scheduled
Nina: eval-bot quick results: shadow reduced spelled-out numerals from 60% -> 6% and restored percent signs in 92% of cases. currency canonicalization still has edge cases for parentheses negative style '(1,234.56)' -> '1,234.56 CR' on some samples.
eval-bot: Eval summary: total=150, numeric_regressions_before=90, numeric_regressions_after=9, percent_loss_cases=12->1, currency_paren_oddities=5
Aisha: good. for the permanent fix: set number_preserve:on in the stitch config, re-stitch, then run int8 quant and the full evalpack. Add a line in the quant notes: "bpe-uncased-v1 may split numeric tokens inconsistently when number_preserve is false; set number_preserve:on for numeric-heavy domains."
Leo: I'll add the CI hook and update the docs. Nina, open MR with the stitch change + evalpack regressions. include a small unit test that tokenizes these 12 golden numeric cases and asserts token ids match baseline.
Nina: MR opened: https://git.redwood/merges/1789 — includes number_preserve toggle, updated marlin-claims-v1 evalpack with 15 numeric golden cases, and a CI test. tagging @Leo @Aisha for review.
Leo: reviewing now. once merged, schedule a dedicated canary next maintenance window and run full dedicated shadow on int8 pool.
Aisha: also note for the rollout checklist: add a step to validate parentheses negative formatting and percent symbol retention specifically for financial/claims models.
Nina: noted. will run full pass after merge and post status here. thanks. :thumbsup:
